lines.en: label makihornytrip4:
scene sky
As the morning comes, the three of us are forced to accept that this was all for nothing.
lines.zh: 清晨降临，我们三个不得不接受：这一切都白费了。

lines.en: Maki is still unmotivated and un-horny, Haruka is still trying to figure out what she’s supposed to do, and I am still the same buffet of misery I have always been — just now with a side of mild paranoia.
lines.zh: Maki 依旧提不起劲、也依旧不发情，Haruka 依旧在琢磨自己该做什么，而我依旧是从前那个「痛苦自助餐」——只是现在多配了一份轻微的妄想。

lines.en: Also, I promise that buffet comparison wasn’t one made out of sheer spontaneity. I speak (or think) to you now from the corner of a white table in a blue room with various pastries spread out before me.
lines.zh: 另外，我保证这个自助餐的比喻并非纯属一时兴起。此刻我正（对你们说，或者想）坐在一间蓝色房间里、白色餐桌的一角，面前摊着各式各样的糕点。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I’m not able to eat anything at all.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，我什么都吃不下。

lines.en: The pit has taken up far too much space.
lines.zh: 那个坑占了太多地方。

lines.en: scene black
Eventually, we leave the resort and return to our normal, unfulfilling lives.
lines.zh: 最终，我们离开了度假村，回到各自正常而缺乏满足的生活。

lines.en: Haruka has to work, Maki has to go home, and I have to wander the streets for yet another Sunday in hopes of finding somewhere to bury my dick until the moon shows up.
lines.zh: Haruka 得上班，Maki 得回家，而我得在又一个周日的街头游荡，盼着能找到个地方把我的鸡巴埋进去，一直埋到月亮升起。

lines.en: As always, my choices are somewhat endless — and I’ll use that thought to carry me forward when my body is reluctant to.
lines.zh: 一如既往，我的选择多得几乎没有尽头——而当我的身体不情不愿时，我会用这个念头撑着自己往前走。

lines.en: One day of rest was not enough to change anything at all.
lines.zh: 一天的休息，不足以改变任何事情。

lines.en: But at least we can take solace in the fact that it was a bit easier to ignore things for a little while.
lines.zh: 但至少我们还算有个安慰：有那么一小会儿，忽略一切变得稍微容易了些。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe1
Anyway, here’s Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: 总之，这里就是 Koi Cafe 了。

lines.en: : Sorry we weren’t able to fix you, Maki. I wish there was something more I could do, but I can’t really afford to take more than a day or two off at a time.
lines.zh: : 抱歉没能把你「修好」，Maki。我真希望我还能多做点什么，可我实在没法一次请超过一两天的假。

lines.en: : Why are you apologizing? This isn’t really something you have any control over in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你道什么歉？这本来就不是你能控制的事。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe2

: I mean...yeah. I just kind of figured there would have been {i}something{/i} yesterday that would have helped in some way. But if it’s more than just stress or whatever, I’ve got literally no idea what I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……是啊。我只是隐约觉得，昨天总该有点{i}什么{/i}能起上点作用。可如果这不只是压力之类的，那我是真的一点都不知道该怎么办了。

lines.en: : Then don’t do anything. Like I said, this isn’t on you. And I never expected your plan to work anyway, so I’m not even let down.
lines.zh: : 那就什么都别做。像我说的，这怪不到你头上。而且我从一开始就没指望你的计划能成，所以我甚至都不觉得失望。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe3
: Was that last part really necessary?
lines.zh: : 最后那句真有必要说吗？

lines.en: : As rude as it sounded, yes. It was necessary — but not to show you I didn’t believe in you. It was to show you that this is something I’m just going to have to get over on my own.
lines.zh: : 虽然听起来很伤人，但有必要。有必要——但不是为了告诉你我不相信你，而是为了告诉你，这件事只能靠我自己熬过去。

lines.en: : Think of it like a cold or the flu or something. Just instead of coughing or throwing up, I lack the desire to shove stuff inside of myself. It happens to everyone.
lines.zh: : 你就当它是感冒还是流感什么的。只不过别人是咳嗽、呕吐，而我是没有把东西塞进自己身体里的欲望。谁都会碰上这种事的。

lines.en: : Hard disagree. But if that’s what you say, I’ll just have to take your word for it. And if there’s anything else you need, don’t hesitate to ask.
lines.zh: : 这点我完全不同意。不过既然你这么说，我也只能信你。还有，如果还有什么别的需要，尽管开口。

lines.en: : I know I haven’t been the best friend, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道我一直算不上最好的朋友，不过——

lines.en: scene harumakicafe4
: Stop putting yourself down. You’ve been great lately and I’m happy to have you by my side.
lines.zh: : 别贬低自己了。你最近很好，有你在我身边我很高兴。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe5
: But, on that note, I must be off! I always say that sex toys sell themselves, but it’s not like money is going to put itself into the register, so yeah.

lines.en: : Think you’ll be able to keep up the “sex is awesome” facade for a little while longer?

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : You really need to ask what {i}I{/i} am doing in a coffee shop? Keeping myself alive, of course.
lines.zh: : 你真要问{i}我{/i}在咖啡店干什么？当然是续命啊。

lines.en: : If I don’t get enough caffeine in the morning, I’ll turn into a demon. Then no one will want to enter the Nodoka in the first place.
lines.zh: : 要是早上摄入的咖啡因不够，我就会变成恶魔。那样一来，根本就不会有人想进 Nodoka 了。

lines.en: : Morning, Nodoka. Black coffee?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Nodoka。黑咖啡？

lines.en: scene harumakicafe29
: Yes, please. And if you could leave a little room for your phone number, it would be greatly appreciated.
lines.zh: : 好的，麻烦了。另外如果你能顺便留出点空位写个电话号码，那就感激不尽了。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Very funny.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe30
: She always thinks I’m joking, that one. Either that or I’m just widely undesirable by those over the age of...sorry, how old are you again?
lines.zh: : 她总以为我在开玩笑，这位姑娘。要么就是我被某个年纪以上的人普遍嫌弃……抱歉，你多大了来着？

lines.en: : I’m 31, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我 31 岁，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Well, I truly hope that isn’t the cutoff. I’d be quite upset if you got {i}bored{/i} of me now that we’re...better acquainted.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真希望那不是分界线。既然我们现在……更熟了，你要是这么快就对我{i}腻{/i}了，我会很难过的。

lines.en: : Better acquainted?
lines.zh: : 更熟了？

lines.en: scene harumakicafe31
: Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just young and curious and in the throes of my first “schoolgirl crush.” How cliche that it’s on my {i}teacher{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 哦，别管我。我只是年轻好奇，正沉浸在人生第一次「女学生暗恋」里。偏偏对象是自己的{i}老师{/i}，多老套啊。

lines.en: : That...seems to be a recurring issue for your class, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这……似乎是你们班的通病吧？

lines.en: : Like I said. {i}Cliche.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就像我说的。{i}老套。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, no shame in following your heart. Here’s your coffee, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 嗯，遵从内心也没什么可羞耻的。你的咖啡，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Thank you, love. Would you be able to put it on my tab? I seem to have misplaced my wallet.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，亲爱的。能记在我账上吗？我好像把钱包弄丢了。

lines.en: : No need. I have an extra one right here.
lines.zh: : 不用了。我这儿正好多出一个。

lines.en: : Isn’t that my-
lines.zh: : 那不是我的——

lines.en: : I’m also willing to...{i}work{/i} for it, if need be. And I’m a very good worker. Just ask Ak- {i}ahem...{/i}Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果有必要的话，我也很愿意……用{i}「劳动」{/i}来抵。而且我干得很好。不信你去问 Ak——{i}咳……{/i}老师。

lines.en: : We were actually just talking about something very similar...
lines.zh: : 我们刚才其实正在聊一件很相似的事……

lines.en: : Just give her the coffee and make her go away.
lines.zh: : 把咖啡给她，然后让她走。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe32
: And to think just recently you were so insistent on making me {i}come{/i} instead. I wonder what’s changed.
lines.zh: : 想想前阵子你还非要让我{i}「来」{/i}呢。真不知道是什么变了。

lines.en: : What’s changed is it’s too early to deal with you right now. You’re not the only one who hasn’t had their morning coffee yet.
lines.zh: : 变的是现在太早了，我应付不了你。没喝上早晨咖啡的可不止你一个。

lines.en: : Then I suppose I might just have to give you a call later...When I’m more {i}bearable...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那我想我只能晚点再给你打电话了……等我变得{i}好相处一点{/i}的时候……

lines.en: scene harumakicafe33
: Oh, Nodoka. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦，Nodoka。你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Why does everyone keep asking me that? I feel as if it should just be assumed at this point that I’m going to show up anywhere beautiful women gather. With priority placed on sites that serve coffee, of course.
lines.zh: : 为什么每个人都问我这个？我觉得到了这个地步，大家干脆默认算了：只要是美女聚集的地方，我就一定会出现。当然，供应咖啡的场所优先。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe34
: Neat. How’s Otoha? I haven’t heard from her today yet.
lines.zh: : 不错。Otoha 怎么样？我今天还没收到她的消息。

lines.en: : And it would probably be best if you didn’t. She is...caught up in the moment once again.
lines.zh: : 你最好还是别收到为好。她又……陷进那股劲头里了。

lines.en: : I figured as much. Oh well. I can wait. She’ll text me when she texts me.
lines.zh: : 我就猜是这样。算了，我等得起。她想发的时候自然会发给我。

lines.en: : My, you’re certainly a lot calmer now that you’re sexually active, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你现在有了性生活，倒是沉稳多了呢。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe35
: And there she goes.
lines.zh: : 她就这么走了。

lines.en: : The female heart is so complicated, isn’t it? How we’ll often run from the exact things that make us feel whole...
lines.zh: : 女人的心真是复杂啊，不是吗？我们总是会从那些恰恰让我们感到完整的东西身边逃开……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Rin just doesn’t want to talk about her sex life at work.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Rin 只是不想在上班的时候聊她的性生活。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe36
: Then I suppose that’s just one more thing that makes her and me so different.
lines.zh: : 那我想，这不过是又一个让她和我如此不同的地方罢了。

lines.en: : Coffee’s brewing right now, Nodoka. But if you want to go take a seat, I’ll run it out to you once it’s done.
lines.zh: : 咖啡正在煮，Nodoka。不过你要是想先去坐，煮好了我给你送过去。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe37
: Fantastic. Will your number be arriving along with it?
lines.zh: : 太好了。到时候你的电话号码会一起送过来吗？

lines.en: : We’ll...see about that.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……再说吧。

lines.en: scene harumakicafe38
Nodoka goes to take a seat and Haruka...is suddenly consumed by a peculiar expression.
lines.zh: Nodoka 过去坐下，而 Haruka……忽然被一种古怪的表情占据了。

lines.en: : Haruka?
lines.zh: : Haruka？

lines.en: scene harumakicafe39
: Oh. Hi. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨。嗯。

lines.en: : Is there...a reason you suddenly look so different?
lines.zh: : 有什么……原因让你看起来突然这么不一样吗？

lines.en: scene harumakicafe40
: Uhh...
scene harumakicafe41
if harukasex == True:
: Maybe we could talk about that the next time you come over?
lines.zh: : 也许下次你来我家的时候我们再聊这个？

lines.en: else:
: I should...probably just get to work.
lines.zh: : 我……大概该去干活了。

lines.en: $ harukadate30skip = True
scene black
I join Nodoka at her table and talk with her for a few minutes while her coffee finishes brewing.
lines.zh: 我到 Nodoka 桌边坐下，陪她聊了几分钟，等她的咖啡煮好。

lines.en: She tells me all about the different ways to make it.
lines.zh: 她跟我讲了煮咖啡的各种不同方法。

lines.en: And I’m stricken by an intense bout of deja vu that feels even more inexplicable than normal.
lines.zh: 而一阵强烈的既视感击中了我，比往常更难以解释。

lines.en: When I leave the cafe, I look back at Haruka.
lines.zh: 离开咖啡店时，我回头看向 Haruka。

lines.en: She both smiles and shakes her head disapprovingly.
lines.zh: 她既在微笑，又不以为然地摇了摇头。

lines.en: And I carry on with the life she wishes she could live while she remains stuck inside.
lines.zh: 而我继续过下去——过的正是她渴望却无法拥有的那种生活，而她则依旧困在里面。

{i}Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Haruka 的好感度提升到了 [haruka_love]!{/i}
